title: 3Sum
description:
Given a list of integers `nums`, find every set of three values, taken from three **different positions**, that adds up to `0`.

Return each triplet with its values in ascending order. The same triplet of values must appear only once, even if it can be formed in several ways. Return the triplets themselves in ascending lexicographic order (compare them value by value from the left).

### Constraints

- `3 <= nums.size() <= 300`
- `-100000 <= nums[i] <= 100000`
- Inputs are passed as function arguments and the answer is returned from the function. Do not read from standard input or print the result.

examples.explanation: Two different triplets sum to zero: -1 + -1 + 2 and -1 + 0 + 1. The triplet [-1, 0, 1] can be formed with either -1, but it is listed once.
Any three of the zeros sum to zero, but they all give the same triplet of values, so the answer has a single entry.
